name: Wakesurfer: Get Gnarly!
summary: A free wakesurfing game you play in your browser, on your phone or computer. Ride behind real wake boats, toss the rope and surf the wave: airs, spins, flips and wake-to-wake transfers across 17 levels, from a glassy local lake and a wave park to river waves, races and a Mega Yacht's giant wave. Made by a Wisconsin wakesurfer.
